description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Leave the owner a short note in their Latchbell inbox (Inbox › Notes & activity), e.g. a customer question you couldn't answer from the notes for customers and what you need from them. Use it when nobody is chatting with you (a run started by an event); when the owner is in the chat, tell them there instead. Up to 300 characters.
name: note_to_owner
title: Leave the owner a note
